subject: [PATCH v2 2/3] mm: page_alloc: make the high-order watermark check honour ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the high-order watermark check in the Linux kernel's page allocation system to honor the ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT flag when it is set. This flag prevents allocations from stealing pages from other migration types, which can lead to fragmentation and slow down memory allocation under memory pressure. The patch makes two changes: it updates the __zone_watermark_ok_mt function to skip checking free lists of other migration types for ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT requests, and it adds a similar check to the __compact_finished function. This change improves the performance of direct compaction by reducing the number of stalls caused by failed allocations.
